definitions.explanation: To come into existence through birth. Used for people, animals, and figuratively for ideas or creations coming into being.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{東京|とうきょう}で{生|う}まれました。
examples.notes: Place of birth uses で particle

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{生|う}まれました。
{何年|なんねん}に{生|う}まれましたか。

notes: This is an intransitive ichidan verb. Often used in past tense {生|う}まれた when talking about birthplace or birth year. The place of birth takes the particle で, while the year/date takes に.
